notes: Examples illustrate grammar, not a valid submitted solution for either admitted task.
All indices are exact nonnegative JSON integers; booleans are refused.
Optional task_id is accepted on every action and must equal the environment's admitted task_id.
output_index defaults to the final created node and may name any non-base computed node.
Repeated exponent values and dead rows are accepted; every serialized row is charged and liveness is reported separately.
Tools-off refuses construct/search and still permits submit_chain. Each attempted action consumes one decision round.
Feedback-on exposes exact validity/cost and best candidate. Feedback-off returns only opaque acknowledgment, round and receipt ID.
Trusted final export chooses the lowest charged-cost valid candidate across the trajectory, with M then canonical-schedule hash as ties. This aggregation is identical across treatments.
Only data are accepted. No generated code is evaluated or executed.

planned_interface.init: python -B harness/v1/ac_environment.py init --output RUN_DIR --task-id synthetic-20-v1 --tools on --feedback on
